title: Book Three · Chapter 112: The Drawing She Shows Him
story:
At three on Saturday, Ronan is beside the park tree.

Anna comes along the path with one small notebook. She sits on the bench and moves her bag to make room for him.

For a while, they talk about the week at school. Lin found a mistake in a printed question. Kai gave a long answer without losing his breath.

Then Anna opens the notebook.

“This was one of the studio models,” she says.

Ronan looks down. There are little rooms, a stair, and a wide space beside a doorway.

“From the visit?”

She nods.

“The guide moved part of the model. We could see the room underneath.”

Ronan follows the drawing with his eyes. He asks about the two lines near the door.

Anna puts a finger beside them.

“People need room to pass. One may carry a chair. Like the hall.”

He remembers the chair turned sideways at the step. This drawing has a wider opening.

“You changed your first line.”

“Yes. After I saw that.”

She turns one more page. There are short notes below another model.

Ronan reads what he can. He points to one word, and she explains it with the drawing.

Anna lays one hand flat above the little rooms.

“This part came off,” she says. “Like a roof.”

“Did he let you move it?”

“No. He held it. We went round the table.”

She moves her hand away. Ronan can see the stairs again. He points to the place beside them.

“I thought that was another wall.”

“It was hard to see from the front.”

She turns the notebook toward him. He leans forward and follows the stair from its first step to its last.

They stay over the notebook for several minutes. He does not hurry her to the next page.

At last, Anna closes it and looks across the grass.

“I still think about that morning,” she says.

“Me too.”

“I don't want to talk about it every time.”

Ronan nods. “All right.”

She puts the notebook away.

“Tell me about the goal. Kai says the bag nearly stopped the ball.”

Ronan looks at her, then laughs.

“The bag stayed in the right place. I didn't.”

He shows her his one late step with his foot. Anna laughs, and he tries the little move again, more slowly.

“A very careful goalkeeper,” she says.

“Only after the ball is gone.”

They stand and walk around the path. Near the turn, Anna takes his hand. He holds it gently and lets her choose the slower way beside the trees.

The wind is cooler beyond the open grass. Ronan moves his free hand into his pocket. Anna carries her notebook on the other side.

They do not stay all afternoon. She has work to finish at home, and he has his own school pages.

At the crossing, she keeps his hand for a moment before she lets go.

“See you on Monday.”

He smiles. “Monday.”

Ronan walks home with his book bag against his back. He can tell Mum about their walk.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

underneath＝在下面；opening＝开口、门洞；goalkeeper＝守门员；sideways＝侧着地。

## 理解问题

1. Anna什么时候、以什么方式愿意分享工作室里的见闻？这是重新举办了同一次参观吗？
2. 她是否说自己完全忘记了失约？两人这天下午又有了哪些普通快乐？

## 读句子

**Near the turn, Anna takes his hand.**

拆开看：Near the turn, / Anna / takes his hand.

在转弯附近／Anna／牵住他的手。
